Students must complete a minimum of 120 units of academic work and a minimum of 32 units of Cooperative Education in order to earn the Bachelor of Science in engineering physics.

","groupId":"4e33c421-3f48-4665-8a42-019591db076f","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"53358385-d7b4-4d52-b93c-019591db8928","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"287866d1-5a17-4b67-8682-019591db8928","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"37241d69-a300-4e29-91ad-019591dc1b34","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note:  Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"bf4a2bbc-b782-4ab3-9786-019591dcf4f2","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"8d845e37-c82e-4ba8-a522-019591dd603b","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"cbc39a33-41c7-4a69-82f7-019591dd603b","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"dbed0468-50a6-43d1-8398-019591f0b79d","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

Students are required to select:

1) Five Courses from Technical Electives Options.

2)Two 100 or 200 level BENG, CIVL, COMP, ECPE, ENGR, EMGT, EPHY, IDEA or MECH courses.

3)AP CHEM scores of 4 or 5, or IB CHEM Higher Level scores of 5, 6, or 7, will satisfy the elective.

4) Students who transfer in with 28 or more units are exempt from taking IDEA 010 and IDEA 020

5) Engineering elective excluding COMP 187, ENGR 181, ENGR 182, ENGR 183, IDEA 010, and IDEA 132.
